hahndorf.name: Hahndorf
hahndorf.price_text: Free to walk · food and drink extra
hahndorf.hours: Village streets always open · shops usually 10:00–17:00, some closed Mon
hahndorf.tip: This is Australia's oldest surviving German settlement. Walk the main street for bakeries, pubs and craft shops.

showgrounds.name: Adelaide Showgrounds
showgrounds.price_text: Varies by event · many free entry
showgrounds.tip: Check the events calendar before you go. The Royal Adelaide Show runs for about a week in early September.
showgrounds.best: Only worth a visit if an event is on

coopers.name: Coopers Brewery
coopers.hours: Tours on set days only · check on the day
coopers.tip: Australia's largest independent brewery. Book a tour in advance and arrange your own transport.

university.name: University of Adelaide
university.price_text: Free to walk the public grounds
university.hours: Campus generally open daytime on weekdays
university.tip: The historic Mitchell Building and Bonython Hall sit right on North Terrace. Walk past them on your way to the museum strip.

beachouse.name: The Beachouse
beachouse.price_text: Pay per ride or buy a pass · check current prices
beachouse.hours: Usually open daily in school holidays · check on the day
beachouse.tip: This is the old Magic Mountain site, now a family fun centre with waterslides and rides. Good for kids on a hot day.

central-market.name: Adelaide Central Market
central-market.hours: Tue–Sat roughly 07:00–17:30 · closed Sun–Mon, check on the day
central-market.tip: Go hungry and graze: cheese, coffee, pastries and produce stalls. Saturday morning is busiest.

rundle-mall.name: Rundle Mall
rundle-mall.hours: Shops usually 09:00–17:30 · late Thu · check on the day
rundle-mall.tip: The main shopping street. Look for the bronze pigs and the old arcades off the mall.

north-terrace.name: North Terrace museum strip
north-terrace.price_text: Free entry to the South Australian Museum and Art Gallery
north-terrace.hours: Usually 10:00–17:00 daily · check on the day
north-terrace.tip: The South Australian Museum, Art Gallery and State Library sit side by side. A good rainy-day plan.

botanic-garden.name: Adelaide Botanic Garden
botanic-garden.price_text: Free entry · some glasshouse areas may charge
botanic-garden.hours: Usually open daily from early morning to sunset · check on the day
botanic-garden.tip: Walk to the Bicentennial Conservatory and the rose garden. Bring water in summer.

glenelg-beach.name: Glenelg Beach and jetty
glenelg-beach.hours: Always open · swim between the flags in patrolled hours
glenelg-beach.tip: Take the tram from the city straight to the beach. Walk the jetty at sunset.

port-adelaide.name: Port Adelaide waterfront walk
port-adelaide.hours: Always open · museums have their own hours
port-adelaide.tip: Old wharves, heritage buildings and the South Australian Maritime Museum. Quiet on weekdays.

maritime-museum.name: South Australian Maritime Museum
maritime-museum.hours: Usually daily 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
maritime-museum.tip: Good for port history and lighthouse exhibits. Combine it with the waterfront walk.

adelaide-oval.name: Adelaide Oval tour
adelaide-oval.price_text: Tour fee · check current prices and times
adelaide-oval.hours: Tours on set times · check on the day
adelaide-oval.tip: One of the world's prettiest cricket grounds. Book a behind-the-scenes tour, or just walk the free riverbank outside.
adelaide-oval.best: Weekday tour; match days are busy

torrens-walk.name: River Torrens Linear Park walk
torrens-walk.tip: Follow the river from the city to the zoo and beyond. Flat, easy and good at sunset.

adelaide-zoo.name: Adelaide Zoo
adelaide-zoo.hours: Usually daily 09:30–17:00 · check on the day
adelaide-zoo.tip: Home to giant pandas and a big open-range area. Buy tickets online to skip the queue.

east-end.name: East End and Ebenezer Place walk
east-end.price_text: Free to walk · food and drink extra
east-end.hours: Cafes and bars open through the day into evening
east-end.tip: Small laneways full of cafes and bars. Good for a coffee stop or an evening meal.

barossa.name: Barossa Valley wine tour
barossa.price_text: Day tours vary widely · check what tastings and lunch are included
barossa.hours: Full-day tours usually leave in the morning
barossa.tip: Book a guided tour so you don't have to drive. Confirm pickup and tasting fees are in the price.

mount-lofty.name: Mount Lofty Summit lookout
mount-lofty.hours: Lookout open daily · visitor centre hours vary
mount-lofty.tip: Best clear-day view over Adelaide and the coast. Bring a jacket; it is cooler up here.

semaphore.name: Semaphore Beach and esplanade
semaphore.hours: Always open · swim in patrolled hours
semaphore.tip: Quieter than Glenelg, with a long esplanade and an old-fashioned foreshore. Take the train from the city.
